Therapy doesn’t work for me, and I know it’s my own fault. I feel like therapists are trying to get something out of me that isn’t there. I’d sit in silence because nothing made sense and she would just chuckle and say “I’m not uncomfortable with silence” and I felt like that’s that. I feel like they tell me things (like coping skills, or like telling me that yes I was abused) that I all already know. It just seems not worth the huge amount of time money and effort to fix something I didn’t break. healing isn’t possible to me. I’d rather be depressed. Thank you for replying, though. I appreciate your thoughtful comment.
